caption: The drawing features a round, reddish-brown ceramic pot with a wide opening and short neck. The main pot has two rope-like handles on either side. The surface of the pot is decorated with an engraved design depicting flowering branches with leaves and a large blossom. Near the top, just below the rim, there is a band of triangular geometric patterns that encircles the pot. The drawing includes two insets: the upper left inset is a close-up of a handle detail, showing its curved and textured form, while the upper right inset is a smaller illustration of the whole pot from a slightly different angle, highlighting its overall shape and proportions. The background is plain and off-white, with the objects outlined by thin rectangular borders.
title: Bean Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
